mass_production.ref: Flat metal griddles likely follow expanding Iron Age cookware in South Asia
mass_production.ref_zh: 南亚铁器时代炊具扩展后出现金属平底烤盘

popularization.ref: Tawa/tava becomes everyday South Asian flatbread and dosa griddle
popularization.ref_zh: tawa/tava成为南亚烙饼与多萨的日常烤盘

locations.place_label_zh: 印度次大陆北部（烙饼烤盘传统）

notes: 印度烤盘（tava/tawa）是日常平底烙锅，但几乎没有可核对的「发明年」。陶石平底加热面更早，金属烤盘随铁器工艺出现，具体世纪缺乏硬证据。本条目以铁器时代以后金属烤盘粗标，并明确标注争议与来源偏弱。
notes_en: The Indian tava/tawa is an everyday flat griddle, but there is almost no verifiable evidence for its invention year. Clay or stone flat cooking surfaces are older; metal griddles likely followed the development of ironworking, yet the century is poorly evidenced. This entry uses a rough post–Iron Age metal-griddle milestone and flags weak sourcing.
summary_zh: tava（tawa）是南亚平底烤盘，用于烙饼与多萨等；金属形制随铁器时代发展，精确发明年证据薄弱，故标争议。
summary_en: The tava (tawa) is a South Asian flat griddle for flatbreads and dosa. Metal forms developed with the Iron Age; weak evidence for the exact invention year makes it disputed.
summary_ja: タワ（tawa）は南アジアの平たい調理板で、フラットブレッドやドーサなどに使う。金属製のものは鉄器時代とともに発展したが、正確な発明年を示す証拠が乏しいため、異説ありとしている。
